newsitem.title: ITALY: DUTCH FINMIN ZALM SEES NO DELAY TO EMU START.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH FINMIN ZALM SEES NO DELAY TO EMU START.

text.p: Dutch Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm said on Wednesday he saw no delay to the start of European monetary and economic union (EMU).
"I don't think so," Zalm said when asked if he believed there would be a delay to the start of EMU.
Zalm spoke to reporters briefly after meeting Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi.
Asked what he and Ciampi had discussed during the meeting and lunch Zalm said "All relevent issues."
Italy's mini-budget proposal was also important. Zalm said.
"We still have to wait and see what the budget will be, but I think it is important that it proves the strength of the Italian government towards reaching a decent budget," he said.
Prodi and Ciampi have worked out a framework for a new budget to ensure Italy is a founding member of the single European currency.
Prodi's office said earlier on Wednesday the package, to be based on structural measures, would be launched in coming weeks, as soon as the Treasury knew how much money had to be raised.
